Help.title: How-to guide
Help.intro: Short walkthroughs of how key processes work in the platform. More sections will be added over time.
Help.acctIntro: Every expense moves through a controlled approval workflow. This keeps spending accountable and the records trustworthy for audits and funders.
Help.step1Body: Anyone with the “record expenses” permission creates an expense. It starts as Pending. You can still edit or delete it while it is Pending.
Help.step2Body: A finance approver reviews and approves it. The approver must be a different person from whoever recorded it — this two-person check prevents fraud and mistakes.
Help.step3Body: Once approved, finance marks it Paid and records how it was paid (cash, bank transfer, UPI, cheque…), the payment date, and a reference such as a UTR or cheque number.
Help.voidBody: Mistakes are never deleted after approval — they are Voided with a reason. The record stays visible for the audit trail but no longer counts toward any total.
Help.lockBody: Once an expense is Approved or Paid it can no longer be edited or deleted. To change it, Void it and record a fresh expense. This protects the financial history from being rewritten.
Help.sodBody: The person who records an expense cannot approve it. If you see a “you recorded this” message, ask another approver to review it.
Help.fundsBody: Link an expense to the grant it is funded from. The finance page then shows each grant’s received, committed, and remaining amounts. Mark a grant Restricted when it may only be spent on its stated purpose — the system blocks any payment that would overspend it. Mark Foreign source for FCRA tracking.
Help.budgetBody: Set a budget per programme. The finance page compares budget against actual (non-voided) spend and flags any programme that has gone over.
Help.rolesBody: Branch admins record expenses for their own district. Finance staff and Admins approve, pay, and void. Admins can do everything, but the separation-of-duties rule (recorder ≠ approver) still applies to everyone.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.purpose: Your starting point: headline numbers for trainees, active cohorts, certificates and pending applications.
how: Open it any time from the top of the sidebar.
Branch admins see only their own district's numbers; the district name is shown as a badge.
Your roles are listed so you can confirm what you're allowed to do.
tips: If a menu item you expect is missing, your role doesn't include that permission — ask an administrator.

districts.title: Districts
districts.purpose: The 31 Karnataka districts (pre-loaded). They group centers, trainees, staff and spending by branch.
how: Search for a district and click Edit to correct its English or Kannada name, code or state.
Districts can't be added or deleted — the list is fixed.
tips: The district code is what the trainee CSV import uses (column districtCode), so keep codes accurate.

centers.title: Centers
how: Click New center, enter the name in English and Kannada, pick the district, and add the address and phone.
Use Edit to update details.
Set the status to Inactive for a center that's no longer used.
tips: A center with cohorts or recorded expenses can't be deleted — set its status to Inactive instead.

programs.title: Programs
programs.purpose: The catalogue of training programs (for example tailoring or electrical work).
how: Click New program and enter the name (and optional description) in both languages, the category and the duration in weeks.
Mark a program inactive when it's no longer offered.
Each batch of a program is run as a cohort.
tips: A program with cohorts, completions, applications or expenses can't be deleted — mark it inactive instead.

cohorts.title: Cohorts
cohorts.purpose: A batch of one program at one center, with dates and a seat capacity.
how: Click New cohort: choose the program and center, give a unique code, dates and capacity. You're taken to the cohort page after saving.
On the cohort page, enroll trainees, assign trainers, and update each trainee's status (Enrolled, Completed or Dropped — add a reason when dropping).
Click Issue certificate for a trainee who has finished. This marks them Completed and creates a certificate anyone can verify by QR code.
To enroll many trainees at once, use Import with a CSV of cohortCode and traineePhone. Check the preview, then commit.
tips: Enrollment is blocked when the cohort is full.
If saving says the code is taken, choose a different cohort code.
A certificate keeps the names as they were when it was issued — fix spellings first.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.purpose: Individual class sessions for a cohort, and the attendance for each.
how: Click New session: pick the cohort and course (required), and optionally the venue, trainer, date, times and topic.
Open a session's Attendance to mark every enrolled trainee Present, Absent, Late or Excused in one go, then save.
You can reopen attendance and save again to correct it.
tips: Marking attendance needs the separate 'mark attendance' permission (trainers have it).

trainees.title: Trainees
trainees.purpose: Trainee records, with their consent recorded under the DPDP Act.
how: Search by name or phone, or click New trainee to add one.
Tick the consent box — it's required, and the consent is recorded.
On a trainee's edit page, use Create portal login to give them access to the trainee portal (email and a password of at least 8 characters).
To add many, use Import with a CSV: firstName is required; lastName, gender, dateOfBirth, phone, email, address and districtCode are optional. Preview, then commit.
tips: Branch admins see, edit and import trainees only in their own district — CSV rows for another district are rejected.
Trainee details are personal data — only record what you need.

trainers.title: Trainers
trainers.purpose: Trainer records, each with their own login.
how: Click New trainer and enter their details plus an email and password. This creates their login with the Trainer role.
Use Edit to update details. The email can't be changed afterwards.
Trainers sign in to their trainer area to record their own daily arrival and departure. They mark trainee attendance from Sessions.
tips: Deleting a trainer also deletes their login.

staff.title: Staff & attendance
staff.purpose: Staff members, their daily attendance and biometric clock-in.
how: Click New staff member and enter their name, phone and role.
Open Attendance, pick a date, mark everyone (Present, Absent, Late, Excused or Holiday, with optional in and out times) and save the whole day.
Open a staff member to see their attendance history and hours, and to Register biometric (fingerprint or Face ID on the device they'll use).
Registered staff can then clock in and out on the Clock page. The first scan of the day checks them in; the next checks them out.
tips: Register biometrics on the same website address staff will use to clock in — a registration only works on the address where it was created.
Branch admins manage staff in their own district only.

applications.title: Applications
applications.purpose: Admission applications submitted on the public website.
how: Filter by status and open an application to review it.
Branch admins review applicants from their district and set Under review, Branch approved or Rejected, adding a note.
A super admin gives the final acceptance and clicks Convert to trainee. This creates the trainee record and can enroll them in a cohort straight away.
tips: An application can be converted only once.
The usual flow: Submitted → Under review → Branch approved → Accepted → Converted (or Rejected).

posts.title: Posts
posts.purpose: News and activity updates shown on the public website.
how: Click New post and add a title, text and an optional photo.
Posts by a super admin go live immediately. Posts by a branch admin stay Pending until a super admin approves them.
Super admins can approve, unapprove (hide) or delete posts.

futurePrograms.title: Future programs
futurePrograms.purpose: Upcoming programs announced on the public site so people can apply early.
how: Click New future program and add a title and description, plus an optional image, objectives, duration and number of seats.
As with posts, branch admin entries wait for super admin approval before they appear publicly.
There's no edit: to change one, delete it and create it again.
tips: People can apply directly to an approved future program. Their application goes to that program's district.

completions.title: Completions
completions.purpose: Records that a participant finished a program, which lets them give feedback and earn a completion certificate.
how: Click New completion and choose the participant and the program (or future program).
The participant then sees a feedback form in their portal.
Delete a completion that was added by mistake.
tips: The same person can't be marked complete twice for the same program.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.purpose: Moderate participant feedback before it appears publicly.
how: Pending feedback is listed first.
A super admin publishes good feedback, which then appears on the programs page, or unpublishes it.
Delete feedback that's inappropriate.

reports.title: Reports
reports.purpose: Organisation-wide numbers for planning and for funders.
how: See the summary, placement outcomes, outcomes over time (3-, 6- and 12-month follow-ups and income uplift) and the district-wise table.
Click Export CSV to download the district table. It opens correctly in Excel, including Kannada.
tips: Reports always cover all districts.

finance.title: Financial management
finance.purpose: A read-only overview of the organisation's money.
how: Check income, spending, balance and budget at the top.
Review spend by status, category and branch, grant utilisation, and budget vs actual.
Use Add expense or Add grant to record new items.
tips: Voided expenses are left out of every total.
A red figure means a restricted grant is overspent or a program is over budget.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.purpose: Record spending and move it through approval and payment.
how: Click New expense and enter the amount, date and category, plus optionally the vendor, grant, program, cohort and center. It starts as Pending.
An approver (not the person who recorded it) opens the expense and clicks Approve.
Finance records the payment — method, date and reference (UTR or cheque number) — and clicks Mark as paid.
To reverse a mistake after approval, Void the expense with a reason.
tips: Only Pending expenses can be edited or deleted.
The Accounting workflow section below explains the full rules.

grants.title: Grants
grants.purpose: Funds received from donors and funders.
how: Click New grant and enter the funder, amount and date received, plus the reference and purpose.
Tick Restricted if the grant may only be spent on its stated purpose. Payments that would overspend it are blocked.
Tick Foreign source for FCRA (foreign contribution) tracking.
Link expenses to the grant so the finance page can show how it was used.
tips: A grant that has expenses charged to it can't be deleted.

users.title: Users
how: Click New user and enter the email, name, password, language and one or more roles.
To make someone a branch admin, give them the Branch admin role and choose their district.
Use Reset password to set a new one (8 or more characters). Set the status to Suspended to block access without deleting the account.
To add many users, use Import with a CSV of name, email, password, locale and roles (separate roles with ;).
tips: Imported users don't get a district — edit them afterwards to assign one.
A role change takes effect the next time that person signs in.
You can't delete your own account.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.purpose: A read-only record of sensitive actions: who created, changed or deleted what, and when — plus blocked sign-in attempts.
how: Filter by entity (for example Expense or Application) and by action.
Each row shows the time, the person and the record affected.
tips: Entries can't be edited or removed.
Blocked entries are sign-in attempts stopped by the too-many-attempts limit.

PortalHelp.title: How to use your portal
PortalHelp.intro: Everything about your training in one place.

items.title: My programs
items.body: Shows each program you're enrolled in and your status: Enrolled, Completed or Dropped.

items.title: My schedule
items.body: Lists your upcoming sessions, and your attendance (Present, Absent, Late or Excused) once it has been marked.

items.title: My certificates
items.body: When you finish a program, your certificate appears here. Open it to view or print it. The QR code on it lets anyone — for example an employer — scan and confirm it's genuine.

items.title: Give feedback
items.body: After a program is marked complete, you can rate it and leave comments. Feedback is reviewed before it appears publicly.

items.title: Edit profile
items.body: Keep your contact details up to date so the team can reach you about classes and job opportunities.

TrainerHelp.title: How to use the trainer area
TrainerHelp.intro: Record your working day and keep track of your attendance.

items.title: Mark your attendance
items.body: Each working day, tap Mark my arrival when you get to the center, and Mark my departure when you leave. Departure asks you to confirm.

items.title: My attendance
items.body: Shows your past days with their status and the hours you worked.

items.title: Class attendance
items.body: Tap Class attendance on your home page to open Sessions, choose the session, then mark which trainees attended.

items.title: If something looks wrong
items.body: "Your arrival is already recorded" means it's saved — just mark your departure at the end of the day. For anything else, contact your center or branch admin.
